items.label: Floor Lamp with On-off Rotary Switch
items.value: You can turn on or off this vintage floor lamp by simply rotating the switch, which is at the perfect spot where you don’t have to get up for operation when sitting on bed or couches. Unlike foot switch, the rotary switch design allows you to put the lamp in any corners of your home and make your floor tidier with power cord hidden

items.label: Durable Standing Lamp
items.value: This 63.8in tall floor lamp features a heavy square base, making it stand straight without wobbling or leaning. Not to worry about it being toppled over by kids or pets. The lamp has a space-saving compact footprint for you to freely tuck it behind sofa or any other corners. The lamp body is crafted from resin in brown finish that prevents it from fading and keeps its rustic look as always

items.label: Eye-caring Bright Lighting
items.value: Equipped with premium faux silk shade, the traditional floor lamp provides soft shaded lighting that creates a soothing and comfortable ambiance. The glare-free light cares for you and your family’s eyes while offering enough illumination to brighten your space. An ideal home lighting for your daily routine like reading, working or relaxing in living room, bedroom or study room

items.label: Vintage Home Decor
items.value: This tall standing lamp adorns the upper body with dark brown ornate scroll and accentuates a rustic vibe by sculptured finial while lending a vintage touch with bell shape lampshade. The carved stepped lamp base also enhances the retro style and luxury. These attractive details make this floor lamp an exceptional match for rooms of any styles

items.label: Easy Assembly & One Bulb Required
items.value: We highly recommend you pair the floor lamp with a A19 or T6 type of LED bulb with warm white light for stressing the vintage flair. The maximum bulb wattage is 100W (Bulb not included). This elegant floor lamp requires assembly but it’s simple enough if you follow the guidance on user manual
